description: This course is designed to apply knowledge of analog electronics & digital electronics to a hands-on laboratory experience. To design and analyze various electronic circuits using p-n junction diode, Zener diode, assemble and make performance measurements on analog circuits. To familiarize students with the working of ICs of logic gates, MUXs, Encoder, Decoder, Flip-Flops etc. To demonstrate students the realization of MUXs/De-MUX, Encoder, Decoder, Flip-Flops etc. with the help of basic ICs.
experiments: PN Junction diode characteristics: (A) Forward bias (B) Reverse bias.
Zener diode characteristics and voltage regulator.
Half wave Rectifier with and without filter & Full wave Rectifier with and without filter.
Introduction to Digital Design Lab - Nomenclature of Digital ICs, Specifications, Study of the Data Sheet, Concept of Vcc and Ground, Verification of the Truth Tables of Logic Gates using TTL ICs.
Study and Verify (a) Demorgan's Theorem for 2 variables. (b) The sum-of product and product-of-sum expressions using universal gates.
Design and implementation of (a) Full Adder using basic logic gates. (b) Full subtractor using basic logic gates.
Implementation and Verification of Decoder/De-Multiplexer and Encoder using Logic Gates.
Realization of the following flip-flops using NAND Gates: (a) Clocked SR Flip-Flop (b) JK Flip-Flop.
Realization of following shift registers using IC7474: (a) SISO (b) SIPO (c) PISO (d) PIPO.
Design and implementation of MOD-12 up and down counter.
outcomes: To demonstrate students the working and input-output characteristics of p-n junction diode, Zener diode.
Construct digital circuit to examine Boolean algebra, truth table of different logic gates.
Design various combinational and sequential circuits after analyzing their timing properties.
Understand the use of digital ICs of different logic functions.
